title: Import & Export
shortDescription: End-to-end sourcing, quality control, and logistics from China to the world.
longDescription: Nadoumi Consulting bridges international businesses with China’s reliable suppliers. We manage the entire import–export process — from sourcing and verification to shipment and compliance — ensuring that every deal is transparent, cost-effective, and on time.
metaDescription: Reliable sourcing and export management from China. We handle supplier verification, quality checks, and international logistics.

title: Student Admission
shortDescription: Personalized university admissions and visa support for studying in China.
longDescription: We guide international students in applying to Chinese universities — from program selection and documentation to scholarships and visa processing. Our team ensures every applicant has a smooth experience from start to finish.
metaDescription: Simplify your university application in China. Get expert support from Nadoumi Consulting for admission, visa, and accommodation.

title: Translation Service
shortDescription: English↔Chinese and French↔Chinese, document translation and on‑site interpretation.
longDescription: Professional translation and interpretation services across China. We translate business, legal, and technical documents, provide on‑site guiding and interpretation for meetings and factory visits, and help with certification when needed.
metaDescription: Chinese↔English and Chinese↔French translation and interpretation in China. Document translation, localization, and certified guidance.
